notes.title: Translations update : FR, ES, RU & JP !
notes.content:
Initially only available in English, Escape Quest is now playable in French, Spanish, Russian or Japanese.
We hope all players not comfortable enough with English will now be able to better understand the in game hints and bring some fun to more people :)

If you find mistakes or missing translations, reach out to us on Discord : https://discord.gg/zEubaAtGG5
